name: CarTrade Tech Limited
summary: CarTrade Tech Limited operates digital automotive marketplaces and related technology platforms in India and internationally. It operates through three segments: Consumer, Remarketing, and Classifieds. The company provides services, including buying, selling, marketing, valuation, and financing of new and pre-owned vehicles. It also offers new car original equipment manufacturers (OEM) solutions that provide OEMs with consumer insights and data-driven solutions for building their digital marketing strategies; new car dealer solutions, which offer customers content and research tools, such as car reviews, on-road prices, car specifications, car images, car finance offers, and others; used car…
